page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 15 at right. One text column of running text in the centre-left; marginal notes in the right margin beside the lower part of the column. Below the text block a catchword "dit" at the right.

main_text.p: bello : Ego contentionem odi, eos qui concordiæ deditì sunt, complectòr amore, venerorque : Quod idem cùm aduersarij nostri non minore charitatis zelo profiteri simulant ; Pereat quisquis pacem oderit, à facie Dei & Angelorum malè pereat : Imò, iam nunc (vt frustra sint hæ diræ) quisquis est, oppidò perijt ; Ad pacis enim præmium venire non possunt, qui pacem Domini discordiæ furore ruperunt, grauiter (quod solet) Cyprianus ; Et certè φιλεγκαῖμονες illi spiritus quid aliud quàm gehennam ambiunt ? Optimè Basilius, Ignis Dei lucem dedit

page.notes: Right margin notes: "Cypr. de simplicitate prælatorum." beside "Et certè"; "Hieron. Euagrio." and "Basil. in Psf.28." beside the final lines. Greek word φιλεγκαῖμονες is as printed and may be imperfect. Notes transcribed as printed; the Hieron. abbreviation reads "Hier." on the scan.
